defmodule ImagePipeline.Pool do
  use GenServer

  @pool_size 10
  @max_wait_ms 5000

  defstruct [:connections, :waiting, :auth_cache]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    connections = for i <- 1..@pool_size, do: %{id: i, busy: false, pid: spawn_worker()}
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{connections: connections, waiting: :queue.new(), auth_cache: %{}}}
  end

  defp spawn_worker do
    {:ok, pid} = ImagePipeline.Worker.start_link()
    pid
  end

  def checkout(token) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:checkout, token}, @max_wait_ms)
  end

  def checkin(conn_id) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:checkin, conn_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:checkout, token}, from, state) do
    case verify_token(token, state.auth_cache) do
      {:ok, user_id, new_cache} ->
        case find_available(state.connections) do
          {:ok, conn} ->
            new_conns = mark_busy(state.connections, conn.id)
            {:reply, {:ok, conn}, %{state | connections: new_conns, auth_cache: new_cache}}
          :none ->
            new_waiting = :queue.in({from, user_id}, state.waiting)
            {:noreply, %{state | waiting: new_waiting, auth_cache: new_cache}}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn_id}, state) do
    new_conns = mark_available(state.connections, conn_id)
    case :queue.out(state.waiting) do
      {{:value, {from, _user_id}}, new_waiting} ->
        case find_available(new_conns) do
          {:ok, conn} ->
            GenServer.reply(from, {:ok, conn})
            {:noreply, %{state | connections: mark_busy(new_conns, conn.id), waiting: new_waiting}}
          :none ->
            {:noreply, %{state | connections: new_conns}}
        end
      {:empty, _} ->
        {:noreply, %{state | connections: new_conns}}
    end
  end

  defp verify_token(token, cache) do
    case Map.get(cache, token) do
      nil ->
        result = do_verify_token(token)
        case result do
          {:ok, user_id} -> {:ok, user_id, Map.put(cache, token, {:valid, user_id})}
          err -> err
        end
      {:valid, user_id} ->
        {:ok, user_id, cache}
    end
  end

  defp do_verify_token(token) do
    expected = Application.get_env(:image_pipeline, :api_token)
    if byte_compare(token, expected) do
      {:ok, extract_user_id(token)}
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp byte_compare(input, expected) when is_binary(input) and is_binary(expected) do
    if byte_size(input) != byte_size(expected) do
      false
    else
      do_byte_compare(input, expected, 0, byte_size(input))
    end
  end
  defp byte_compare(_, _), do: false

  defp do_byte_compare(_input, _expected, pos, len) when pos >= len, do: true
  defp do_byte_compare(input, expected, pos, len) do
    if :binary.at(input, pos) == :binary.at(expected, pos) do
      do_byte_compare(input, expected, pos + 1, len)
    else
      false
    end
  end

  defp extract_user_id(token) do
    token |> Base.decode64!() |> String.split(":") |> List.first()
  rescue
    _ -> "anonymous"
  end

  defp find_available(connections) do
    case Enum.find(connections, fn c -> !c.busy end) do
      nil -> :none
      conn -> {:ok, conn}
    end
  end

  defp mark_busy(connections, id) do
    Enum.map(connections, fn c -> if c.id == id, do: %{c | busy: true}, else: c end)
  end

  defp mark_available(connections, id) do
    Enum.map(connections, fn c -> if c.id == id, do: %{c | busy: false}, else: c end)
  end
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.Worker do
  use GenServer

  def start_link do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, [])
  end

  def init(_) do
    {:ok, %{processing: false}}
  end

  def process_image(pid, image_data, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:process, image_data, opts}, 30_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:process, image_data, opts}, _from, state) do
    result = apply_transforms(image_data, opts)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  defp apply_transforms(data, opts) do
    data
    |> maybe_resize(opts[:width], opts[:height])
    |> maybe_convert(opts[:format])
    |> maybe_compress(opts[:quality])
  end

  defp maybe_resize(data, nil, nil), do: data
  defp maybe_resize(data, w, h) do
    # Simulated resize operation
    %{data: data, transform: {:resize, w, h}}
  end

  defp maybe_convert(data, nil), do: data
  defp maybe_convert(data, format) do
    %{data: data, transform: {:convert, format}}
  end

  defp maybe_compress(data, nil), do: data
  defp maybe_compress(data, quality) when quality >= 1 and quality <= 100 do
    %{data: data, transform: {:compress, quality}}
  end
  defp maybe_compress(data, _), do: data
end

defmodule ImagePipeline.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  post "/api/images/transform" do
    token = get_req_header(conn, "authorization") |> List.first() || ""

    case ImagePipeline.Pool.checkout(token) do
      {:ok, pool_conn} ->
        {:ok, body, conn} = read_body(conn)
        opts = parse_transform_opts(conn.query_params)
        result = ImagePipeline.Worker.process_image(pool_conn.pid, body, opts)
        ImagePipeline.Pool.checkin(pool_conn.id)
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", result: result}))
      {:error, :unauthorized} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "unauthorized"}))
      {:error, _reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 503, Jason.encode!(%{error: "service unavailable"}))
    end
  end

  defp parse_transform_opts(params) do
    [
      width: parse_int(params["w"]),
      height: parse_int(params["h"]),
      format: params["fmt"],
      quality: parse_int(params["q"])
    ]
  end

  defp parse_int(nil), do: nil
  defp parse_int(s) do
    case Integer.parse(s) do
      {n, _} -> n
      :error -> nil
    end
  end
end
